top_choice_rationale: Pd-catalysed C-N cross-coupling is the most mature and fully settled achievement on the slate: a new bond-forming reaction with a defined catalytic cycle, rational ligand evolution, 25+ years of independent confirmation and routine use in medicinal chemistry and process manufacture. Buchwald and Hartwig independently made it general, so two names fit the three-laureate limit without an exclusion, and the citation wording handles the Kosugi/Migita stoichiometric precedent. It addresses a distinct mechanistic problem from the 2010 C-C coupling prize. Base editing ranks second: genuine new chemistry (evolved TadA) but young, with the Kondo/Nishida priority question unresolved.
